sections.title: Objects near the listener
sections.content: When an object is closer to the person you are speaking to (there / *ahí*), use **ese** (masculine singular), **esa** (feminine singular), **esos** (masculine plural), or **esas** (feminine plural).

items.spanish: Esa chaqueta que tienes es bonita.
items.english: That jacket you have is pretty.
I want those apples right there.

sections.content: A handy memory trick: *This and these have T's, that and those don't!* (es**t**e/es**t**a = this; ese/esa = that).
